Patch 0.1.25

Fix: update Apply no longer leaves Manafall closed when install fails.

What went wrong
- After download, Apply quits the game to unpack the zip
- With the drive almost full (about 2 GB free), unpack failed
- The game stayed closed, so it looked like a crash on restart

What this does
- Checks free disk before quitting to Apply
- If Apply still fails, relaunches Manafall and writes Manafall-patch-failed.txt on the Desktop
- Shows a short error dialog instead of dying silently

This is a small script Apply. Free several GB on C: before taking a large content update (ore materials from 0.1.23).
